biggest_catch: You must already own mowing equipment plus a truck/SUV — this is not a zero-equipment side gig.
catches: Requires your own mower, trimmer, blower, and a truck or SUV — real equipment costs.
Must be authorized to work in the US and pass a background check.
LawnStarter takes a small portion of each mowing price (platform cut).
No bidding, but also no pricing power — LawnStarter's software prices each lawn.
Income is per-job and seasonal; the '$1,000+/week' figure is a top-pro marketing claim, not a promise.

c1.evidence: LawnStarter's own provider page describes the marketplace: providers are independent contractors who 'use the LawnStarter Pro app to find and service customers', claim pre-priced jobs in the app, and get paid weekly — 'No Lead Fees, No Risk' — a real, public deal channel with $400M+ paid to 19,700+ providers per the official blog.

c2.evidence: Official pages publish no fixed per-job pay range — providers 'see the pay before claiming a job'; the $1,000+/week top-pro figure is marketing, not a guaranteed rate — framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: sign up free, pass background check, claim jobs in the app, complete work, weekly direct deposit.

c4.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Nothing! LawnStarter takes a small portion of the mowing price but never charges our providers to use the service' — no signup, subscription, or lead fees.

eligibility: US-based adults authorized to work who own mowing equipment and a truck/SUV and can pass a background check.
notes: Scenario: local services (lawn care). LawnStarter is a lawn-care marketplace: customers book through the platform, providers claim pre-priced jobs in the Pro app, and get paid weekly by direct deposit. Income is per-job and variable — never guaranteed.
numeric_basis: payout: per-job pay shown before claiming, no official fixed range. time: free signup (minutes) + background check wait + claiming first job; active setup est. 30-60 min.
payout_quote: You get paid exactly what you see when a job is offered to you.
payout_value_note: Per-job pay is shown before claiming; LawnStarter publishes no fixed pay range — variable per-job income.

steps: Sign up free as a LawnStarter Pro (takes a few minutes).
Pass the background check and provide bank info for weekly direct deposit.
Open the Pro app and claim pre-priced jobs near you — you see the exact pay before claiming.
Complete the mowing/service and mark it done in the app.
Get paid weekly via direct deposit (keep 100% of tips).
timing: Jobs are claimed continuously in the app; payouts land weekly via direct deposit.
